body:
I originally bought a 8mg strip of Suboxone from a friend. I had told him my back was badly in pain and I was awaiting a chiropractor and needed some pain meds for the coming days until my appointment was scheduled. He suggested I try Suboxone. He said it was more potent than hydrocodone and Oxycontin.
I did my research online and found it was used to counter the effects of opioid overdose. And that 1mg was equivalent to about 20-40 mg of hydrocodone. I have no tolerance so I worked my way up to 1mg over the course of two hours. Taking 4 strips of .25 mg of the suboxone strip.
Effects:
Post-anesthesia effect
Dizziness
Next Day after:
Bad Nausea
Headache
Upset stomach
Bodily discomfort
After the suboxone wore off the next day, it was the most miserable moment in my life for the next 8-12 hours.
After the suboxone wore off the next day, it was the most miserable moment in my life for the next 8-12 hours.
I had to go to work that next day. The 2 hours before work I was laying down resting with an ice pack to my head. I honestly think this helped make the day not suck even worse. But once I got to work, then the horrible after effects kicked in and it was the most miserable, torturous day I have ever had in my life. I was badly nauseated, my head was pressurized and felt like I was sick, my stomach was very upset and my entire body was in a state of discomfort. I was also dizzy to no end. I could barely function at work but eventually made my way through.
I read through experience reports before I took it. It is not something I would want to use recreational... Not worth it at all... I only took 1mg of it and had the worst day of my life.
The high I would get from it does not outweigh the cons.
